faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT(BHU) Varanasi SRF recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 25 September 2026. It is advisable to submit your application well in advance of the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 42000 plus 20% House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the SRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a First Class M. Pharm/M. S. (Pharm.)/M. Tech (Pharm)/M. Tech in Medicinal Chemistry/Pharmaceutical Chemistry or a Second Class degree with a PhD or one year of industrial/research experience. A valid GATE/GPAT/CSIR-UGC-NET qualification is also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Fellow (SRF) position is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the IIT(BHU) Varanasi SRF position?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach required documents, and send it to the official email address specified in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the post of Senior Research Fellow (SRF).

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the SRF role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Senior Research Fellow (SRF) is contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IIT(BHU) Varanasi located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) Varanasi is located in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 221005.
